title: Observability Inequality for a Multi-Dimensional Degenerate Schrödinger Equation with an Interior Degeneracy Point
summary: We study the observability inequality for a multi-dimensional degenerate Schrödinger equation possessing an interior degeneracy point, where the principal coefficient vanishes at the origin inside the domain and breaks ellipticity. Within a weighted Sobolev space, we establish the spectral properties, well-posedness, and regularity estimates for the degenerate operator. To tackle the failure of classical controllability tools, we develop a regularization approximation scheme. We construct a sequence of non-degenerate approximating problems.
